permissions.link_own: Change the linked title of their own discussions
permissions.link_any: Change the linked title of any discussion

admin.tmdb_token_help: Movies and TV shows come from The Movie Database. Get a token from your TMDB API settings and paste the long API Read Access Token here. It stays on the server.
admin.igdb_help: Games come from IGDB, which Twitch runs. Register an app in the Twitch developer console (Twitch asks for two-factor authentication on your account first; client type Confidential, redirect URL https://localhost), make a client secret, and paste both here. The secret stays on the server. IGDB is free for non-commercial forums; a commercial forum needs a partnership with IGDB.
admin.deepl_help: Game descriptions come from Wikipedia in the data language when it has the game. The rest of IGDB's game data and most book descriptions from Open Library come in English. With a DeepL key, Marquee translates game and book descriptions and book subjects into the data language (game genres and modes are translated by the forum's language files) once per title and keeps the translation. Get a free DeepL API key: the free plan translates 500,000 characters a month, enough for thousands of titles. The key stays on the server.
admin.language_help: The language movie and TV titles, synopses and genres come in, as a code such as fr, fr-FR or pt-BR. Leave it blank to follow the forum's default language. IGDB's game data is in English (it has Japanese and Korean names only), so game descriptions come from Wikipedia in this language where it has the game, and the rest is translated if you add a DeepL key; album data is the artists' own, and book titles, covers and publishers follow it where Open Library has an edition in that language (book descriptions are mostly in English). Titles already linked switch language when they next refresh.
admin.list_posters_label: Show posters in the discussion list
admin.list_posters_help: A small poster next to each linked discussion. Turn it off if another extension, such as FoF Discussion Thumbnail, already shows thumbnails there.
admin.title_year_help: Discussion titles and the card read "Final Fantasy VII Remake (2020)". Turn it off for "Final Fantasy VII Remake"; the card still shows the date. Applies to titles linked from now on; existing discussion titles keep their year until renamed.
admin.list_meta_label: What the discussion list shows under a linked discussion
admin.list_meta_help: Shown beside the author line. A TV season or episode code (Season 2, S03E03) shows under both of the first two choices.
admin.show_scores_label: Show scores and ratings on the card
admin.show_scores_help: TMDB user scores, IGDB critic and member ratings and Open Library ratings, on the card, seasons and episodes.
admin.show_source_link_label: Show the "View on TMDB / IGDB…" button
admin.show_source_link_help: The button under the card that opens the title on its source. The small attribution line ("Game data from IGDB.com", TMDB's notice) always shows: TMDB requires its notice and IGDB's terms ask for credit.
admin.tags_help: When someone starts a discussion under one of these tags, the title field searches that source and the discussion shows the title's card in its header. Every other tag keeps the normal composer.

api.link_invalid: That title could not be linked. Pick it again from the list.
api.link_unavailable: The title source could not be reached, so the title was not linked. Try again in a moment.

picker.placeholder_music: Search for an album or artist
picker.placeholder_book: Search for a book by title, author or ISBN
picker.unavailable: {source} is not answering right now. You can still post with a plain title.

hero.season_failed: This season could not be loaded right now.

link.related_help: The rest of a series, for example the other games of a trilogy. They show as a row on the card, and clicking one shows its card in place.
link.title: Linked title
link.none: This discussion isn't linked to a title.
